name: Kellerstüberl
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the cozy heart of Tirol!**

Discover the **Kellerstüberl** – the traditional cellar taverns where rustic charm meets hearty hospitality. Nestled in the picturesque landscapes of Tirol, these hidden gems offer a taste of authentic Tyrolean culture.

Savor classic dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Tiroler Gröstl**, or a steaming bowl of **Käsespätzle**, paired with crisp local beers or smooth **Schnaps**. Whether you're exploring the vibrant streets of **Innsbruck**, the alpine beauty of the **Zillertal**, or the serene valleys of the **Ötztal**, a **Kellerstüberl** awaits to warm your soul.

Experience Tirol like a local – where every bite tells a story and every sip feels like home. **Prost!** 🍻
